name: pattaya_landmarks
note: Landmark proxies (tools/mapgen/landmarks.py). Positions/footprints come only from the OSM elements listed per landmark (data/osm/raw). Heights: OSM height / building:levels when tagged (levels x level_studs + ground_floor_extra_studs, the buildings.py rule), otherwise the real-world height in height_m (public reference, stated per landmark) x vertical studs per metre (vertical_scale / meters_per_stud, the city's building scale). Names are plain descriptive text; no logos, no official artwork.
